main_text.p: componit,& Sabbatium ducit Byzantium:vbi tum[illegible, ~2 letters] ille ad bestias condemnatus est, nisi ab hoc mortis[illegible, ~2 letters] genere per humanitatem regiam fuisset liberatus.[illegible, ~2 letters] Hormisdas autem Saramen aduersus Baram mit-[illegible, ~2 letters] tit, qui Baram cum bello superior cuasisset, Sara-[illegible, ~2 letters] men elephantis obiccit deuorandum,& manifesta[illegible, ~2 letters] contra Hormisdam sumsit arma. Eò verò hono-[illegible, ~2 letters] rum Baram venerat, priusquam deficeret, vt post[illegible, ~2 letters] regem nemo foret eo honoratior. curator enim e-[illegible, ~2 letters] rat palatij, quem vocant Romani, quo honore ex-[illegible, ~2 letters] cidit. Habetur porrò hoc libro etiam repetitio eo-[illegible, ~2 letters] rum,quæ euenerunt temporibus hisce antiquiori-[illegible, ~2 letters] bus, & succincta narratio eorum, quæ facta sunt[illegible, ~2 letters] sub Imperio Iustini ac Tiberij Imperatorum. quæ-[illegible, ~2 letters] dam item de crudelitate Hormisdæ Persarum re-[illegible, ~2 letters] gis, & Persicorum regum stirpis commemoratio.[illegible, ~2 letters] Et hæc ea sunt quæ liber Tertius.

QVARTVS vero continet, & quomodo inter[illegible, ~1 letter] Persas ciuile bellum coaluerit,& quæcunq; accide-[illegible, ~2 letters] rint sub Baramo victoriaq; & fortunæ. Pherecha-mis cædem. Zadestræ successum, & quomodo re-[illegible, ~3 letters] gno à Bindoe exutus Hormisdas è vinculis con-[illegible, ~2 letters] cionandi petierit veniam, quomodoq; fit concio-natus, & quomodo Bindoes itē concionatus fit,[illegible, ~2 letters] iugulatusq; filius in conspectu Hormisdæ, occisaq;[illegible, ~2 letters] regina, & excæcatus ipse Hormisdas. & quomodo[illegible, ~2 letters] postea à filio quem Persæ regem constituerant, fu-[illegible, ~2 letters] stibus occisus. potentiam tyrannidis Barami, fu-[illegible, ~2 letters] gamáque chosroæ Persarum regis. quomodo item[illegible, ~2 letters] Persarum rex ad Circensium venerit ad Mauri-[illegible, ~2 letters] cium Imperatorem, quomodoq; ad eum miserit.[illegible, ~2 letters] de Ba-
